text:
sam-sales: FYI FieldBridge dispute resolution: they claim misconfigured routing led to 2 months of undercounted usage, asking for a retroactive credit of $32,400 spread across next two invoices + a 10% discount for month 1 of remediation. want internal sign-off so we can issue credit and updated invoice.
jo-finance: need the raw usage logs and reconciliation worksheet. also need to confirm whether credit should be contra-revenue or AP receivable reversal.
tess-dealdesk: recommend conditional approval: a) credit capped at $32,400, b) apply 50% to next invoice and 50% to following invoice, c) 10% one-time discount on remediation month, d) require FieldBridge to sign an incident acceptance and waiver for further credits.
marc-cfo: ok to proceed if finance confirms margin impact and legal signoff on waiver. what's expected margin after credit?
revenue-bot: Auto-report: Projected GAAP impact = reduce recognized revenue by $32,400 this quarter. Gross margin delta = -3.2 percentage points. Runbook: Ticket REV-10555. Link: https://redwood.internal/revenue/REV-10555
jo-finance: accounting note: treat as contra-revenue on invoice adjustments. GL: SALES_CREDIT. For internal tracking, open receivable recovery if waiver not signed. I'll prepare journal entry template.
rachel-legal: will draft a short acceptance statement + waiver of further claims for the incident window. also request we add the amendment to the contract stating credit mechanics and no admission of liability.	sam-sales: FieldBridge legal ready to sign; they also request Net45 payment terms on revised invoices. we prefer to keep existing Net30.
tess-dealdesk: can we accept Net45 for the two revised invoices as a one-off if we include an invoice-level interest clause for overdue amounts and require payment method as ACH?
marc-cfo: no to Net45. Accept Net30 only. If sales want to keep the deal, propose a compromise: Net30 + 1% early payment discount if paid within 10 days.
revenue-bot: Update: REV-10555 status -> awaiting docs (reconciliation CSV, signed waiver). Assigned: jo-finance, rachel-legal, tess-dealdesk.
jo-finance: I'll validate the reconciliation and post the ledger entries once waiver received. Also need cost-center allocation for credit: REVENUE_ADJ_03.
marc-cfo: approving credit issuance conditional on signed waiver and confirmed reconciliation. Tess, please file DD-10555 in Deal Desk with these conditions.
tess-dealdesk: filed DD-10555, status: approved-conditional. I'll notify the billing team to prepare the revised invoices once docs are in.
sam-sales: I'll push FieldBridge to sign waiver today and upload the reconciliation CSV. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
